name: Caprese "Eyeballs" with Basil, Tomato, Mozzarella & Black Olives

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and pick 24 large basil leaves off the stems (if needed, you can double up smaller leaves to make larger ones). Arrange leaves on a serving platter, spacing them at least 1/4-inch apart.
Wash, dry, and cut each tomato crosswise into 4 slices. Arrange slices on top of the basil leaves.
Count out 12 mozzarella balls and cut each in half. Top tomato slices with a piece of mozzarella, flat-side facing down.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella balls (ciliegine or "cherry size")

instructions.primary_message: Count out 24 sliced olives. Place one olive over each piece of mozzarella.
Just before serving, season caprese "eyeballs" with salt and pepper, then drizzle with oil and vinegar. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp balsamic vinegar
